howToUse: Each key under 'assets' maps one generated image to its ready-to-post caption. Automation should join on 'assetPath' (the exact relative path from the koolestpro-cowork-v2 project root) or on the key itself. 'status' tracks whether that specific asset+caption pairing has actually been posted; it is separate from, and does not affect, the pipeline item's own status in ridwan_content_system_updated.html (which only ever reaches 'Ready', never 'Published', per CLAUDE.md).
brandSafety: Versed is not a Koolestpro client. Every caption in this file already carries an explicit unofficial-concept disclaimer. Do not remove it when posting.

knownGaps: None. All 5 images exist on disk and were visually reviewed on 2026-08-21 before being recorded here. combined-showcase.png is 1072x1584 / 1.72MB, under the ~4MB X ceiling, so no compressed -x variant was needed.

SA-VERSED-PROBLEM.caption: Name the annoyance before the product turns up. Moisturizer that leaves oily skin shiny by noon, then the jar in the corner as the fix. This is the problem/solution angle for Versed's Dew Point gel-cream. Unofficial concept work built from Versed's own public product info, not something the brand commissioned. The product shot is AI generated.

SA-VERSED-BENEFIT.caption: Absorbs instantly. Never greasy. Sits under makeup. Won't clog pores. Four callouts wired straight to the jar, and every one of them came off Versed's own product page. The benefit/result angle for Dew Point Gel-Cream Moisturizer. Unofficial concept work built from Versed's own public product info, not something the brand commissioned. The product shot is AI generated.

SA-VERSED-PROOF.caption: 4.7 stars from 456 reviews, and a real buyer calling it a fresh glass of water for thirsty skin. Let the customer's line carry the claim instead of the brand's. The social proof angle for Versed's Dew Point. Unofficial concept work built from Versed's own public product info, not something the brand commissioned. The product shot is AI generated.

SA-VERSED-OFFER.caption: There was no live Versed promo to point at, so the urgency comes from the cart rather than a made-up countdown. Still thinking about it, $14.99, one CTA bar you can't scroll past. The offer/urgency angle for Dew Point. Unofficial concept work built from Versed's own public product info, not something the brand commissioned. The product shot is AI generated.

SA-VERSED-COMBO.caption: Four static ad directions for Versed's Dew Point gel-cream moisturizer: problem/solution, a benefit breakdown, social proof, and a cart-urgency frame.
